extracted.intended_audience: Ambizione grantees, rejected Ambizione applicants, SNSF project grant beneficiaries, and Ambizione host institutes (survey participants)
extracted.subtask_description: Questionnaire instrument used to evaluate the SNSF Ambizione funding scheme, asking past grantees, rejected applicants, comparable SNSF project beneficiaries, and host institutes about motivations, satisfaction, support, impacts, career outcomes and possible improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfaction with information/advice from the SNSF (application procedure)
rubrics_metrics.description: How satisfied were you with the information/advice from the SNSF? (Response options: Very satisfied / Rather satisfied / Rather unsatisfied / Not at all satisfied / Not applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Asked as part of assessing satisfaction with the application procedure; respondents should tick the option that best applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfaction with administrative effort involved in the application
rubrics_metrics.description: How satisfied were you with the administrative effort involved in the application? (Very satisfied / Rather satisfied / Rather unsatisfied / Not at all satisfied / Not applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates burden of administration for applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfaction with submission requirements (deadlines, two-stage evaluation etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: How satisfied were you with the submission requirements (deadlines, two-stage evaluation procedure, etc.)? (Very satisfied / Rather satisfied / Rather unsatisfied / Not at all satisfied / Not applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures perceptions of procedural fairness/clarity and practical requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfaction with time to decision
rubrics_metrics.description: How satisfied were you with the time it took before you received the decision? (Very satisfied / Rather satisfied / Rather unsatisfied / Not at all satisfied / Not applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses timeliness of SNSF decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Motives: Option of returning or coming to the Swiss science community
rubrics_metrics.description: How significant was the motive 'Option of returning or coming to the Swiss science community' for your Ambizione application? (Very significant / Rather significant / Rather insignificant / Completely insignificant / Not applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of several motive-items asking applicants why they applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Motives: Option of developing one's own research focuses
rubrics_metrics.description: How significant was the motive 'Option of developing one's own research focuses' for your Ambizione application? (Very significant / Rather significant / Rather insignificant / Completely insignificant / Not applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses desire for independent research direction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Motives: Option of studying new research questions
rubrics_metrics.description: How significant was the motive 'Option of studying new research questions' for your Ambizione application? (Very significant / Rather significant / Rather insignificant / Completely insignificant / Not applicable)

rubrics_metrics.name: Motives: Reputation of the Ambizione funding scheme
rubrics_metrics.description: How significant was the 'Reputation of the Ambizione funding scheme' as a motive? (Very significant / Rather significant / Rather insignificant / Completely insignificant / Not applicable)

rubrics_metrics.name: Motives: Attractiveness of the Ambizione funding scheme
rubrics_metrics.description: How significant was the 'Attractiveness of the Ambizione funding scheme' as a motive? (Very significant / Rather significant / Rather insignificant / Completely insignificant / Not applicable)

rubrics_metrics.name: Motives: Option of going to another Swiss research institution
rubrics_metrics.description: How significant was the 'Option of going to another Swiss research institution' for your application? (Very significant / Rather significant / Rather insignificant / Completely insignificant / Not applicable)

rubrics_metrics.name: How applicants found their Ambizione host institute
rubrics_metrics.description: How did you find your Ambizione host institute (multiple answers possible): I knew my host institute thanks to personal contacts; due to earlier stays; I was already employed there; recommended by scientific mentors/colleagues; found by other means.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple selections allowed; documents recruitment pathways and networks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasons for choosing the host institute
rubrics_metrics.description: Why did you choose your host institute (multiple answers possible): Reputation of the host institute; reputation of scientists there; importance in research field; existing links; infrastructure; employment conditions; family/personal reasons; other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures criteria used by applicants when selecting host.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfaction with support/advice from the SNSF (during grant)
rubrics_metrics.description: How satisfied were/are you with the support/advice from the SNSF? (Very satisfied / Rather satisfied / Rather unsatisfied / Not at all satisfied / Not applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses ongoing administrative/scientific support after award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfaction with the amount of the awarded Ambizione grant
rubrics_metrics.description: How satisfied were/are you with the amount of the awarded Ambizione grant? (Very satisfied / Rather satisfied / Rather unsatisfied / Not at all satisfied / Not applicable)

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfaction with the duration of the awarded Ambizione grant
rubrics_metrics.description: How satisfied were/are you with the duration of the awarded Ambizione grant? (Very satisfied / Rather satisfied / Rather unsatisfied / Not at all satisfied / Not applicable)

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfaction with support received from the host institute
rubrics_metrics.description: How satisfied were/are you with the support received from the host institute? (Very satisfied / Rather satisfied / Rather unsatisfied / Not at all satisfied / Not applicable)

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfaction with infrastructure at the host institute
rubrics_metrics.description: How satisfied were/are you with the infrastructure at the host institute? (Very satisfied / Rather satisfied / Rather unsatisfied / Not at all satisfied / Not applicable)

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfaction with integration into the host institute
rubrics_metrics.description: How satisfied were/are you with the integration into the host institute? (Very satisfied / Rather satisfied / Rather unsatisfied / Not at all satisfied / Not applicable)

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasons for dissatisfaction (open-ended)
rubrics_metrics.description: Why were/are you not satisfied with [support/advice from SNSF, amount, duration, support from host, infrastructure, integration]? (open-ended)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Free-text follow-ups allow respondents to explain dissatisfaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Host institute support mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: By what specific means did/does your host institute support you? (multiple answers possible): use existing infrastructures; host financially supported acquisition of new infrastructure; host acquired new infrastructure; additional financial support for activities at host institute (e.g. teaching); additional financial support for own research; further support (specify).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documents material and financial support provided by host.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparison of status with other postdocs at host institute
rubrics_metrics.description: How would you describe your status as Ambizione grantee at the host institute as compared to postdocs at the institute who received funding from other sources? (Respondent may note 'There were no other postdocs at the institute' or describe differences).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures perceived status differences related to funding source.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of support personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Were/are you supported by doctoral students, postdocs and/or other personnel in your Ambizione research work? (No / Yes). If yes, what type: Doctoral students; Postdocs; Other personnel (e.g. assistants, technicians, etc.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Number and funding of doctoral students
rubrics_metrics.description: How many doctoral students? How were they funded? (Fully funded through the Ambizione grant; Partially by Ambizione/host; Fully financed through host funds; Other financing; Don't know)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantifies supervision resources and funding sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number and funding of postdocs
rubrics_metrics.description: How many postdocs? How were they funded? (50% Ambizione/50% host; To more than 50% but not entirely with host funds; Fully financed through host funds; Other financing; Don't know)

rubrics_metrics.name: Number and funding of other personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: How many other personnel? How were they funded? (Fully funded through Ambizione; Partially Ambizione/host; Fully financed through host funds; Other financing; Don't know)

rubrics_metrics.name: Significance of supervision for scientific independence
rubrics_metrics.description: What significance did/does the supervision of doctoral students/postdocs/other personnel have for your scientific independence? (Very high significance / Considerable significance / Low significance / No significance / Don't know)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses whether leading personnel contributed to researcher independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Involvement in teaching during Ambizione grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Were/are you involved in teaching activities at the host institute during your Ambizione grant? (Yes / No). If yes, scope (hours/week per semester incl. prep), at which level (Bachelor/Master/Doctoral/Other), how financed (Fully Ambizione / Partially Ambizione/host / Fully host / Other / Don't know)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documents teaching obligations and their impact/financing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significance of teaching involvement for scientific independence
rubrics_metrics.description: What significance did/does the involvement in teaching have for your scientific independence? (Very high significance / Considerable significance / Low significance / No significance / Don't know)

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact: improved competence in research field
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ambizione grant has... improved my competence in my research field. (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of multiple impact items; uses same response scale for perceived effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact: enhanced scientific profile
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ambizione grant has... enhanced my scientific profile. (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact: increased scientific competitiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ambizione grant has... increased my scientific competitiveness. (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact: improved (international) networking
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ambizione grant has... improved my (international) networking. (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact: easier access to leading scientists
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ambizione grant has... given me easier access to leading scientists in my research field. (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact: increased number of scientific publications
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ambizione grant has... increased the number of my scientific publications. (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact: improved quality of scientific publications
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ambizione grant has... improved the quality of my scientific publications. (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact: enabled foothold in Swiss science scene after stay abroad
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ambizione grant has... enabled me to gain a foothold in the Swiss science scene after a stay abroad. (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Other perceived impacts (open-ended)
rubrics_metrics.description: Did/does your Ambizione grant have any other impacts? (No / Yes, namely: [open text])
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows respondents to report impacts not covered by fixed items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discipline-specific criteria for scientific independence
rubrics_metrics.description: The concept of scientific independence is interpreted differently in different disciplines. What are the criteria for scientific independence in your discipline? (open-ended)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open-text elicits discipline-specific standards of independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contribution of Ambizione grant to scientific independence
rubrics_metrics.description: What kind of contribution has the Ambizione grant made to your scientific independence in this sense? (A very large contribution / A rather large contribution / A rather small contribution / No contribution / Don't know)

rubrics_metrics.name: Influence of Ambizione grant on further career
rubrics_metrics.description: Did/does the Ambizione grant have a substantial influence on your further career? (Yes / No). If yes/how or why not? (open-ended)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses career trajectories attributable to the grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feasibility of carrying out the project without Ambizione funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Could your research project have been carried out / have been started without the Ambizione grant? (Yes / No). If yes/how or why not? (open-ended)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures counterfactual on necessity of funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career destinations after Ambizione grant (institutions and countries)
rubrics_metrics.description: At what kind of institutions and where have you worked from the end of your Ambizione grant up to now? (multiple answers possible across universities, applied sciences, research institutions outside academia, private sector, other; in Switzerland / in another country).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maps post-grant career locations and sectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Further funding received after Ambizione grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Have you received further funding after your Ambizione grant? (No / Yes, namely: further SNSF funding [Marie Heim-Vögtlin grants, SNSF professorship, Other SNSF funding] / Funding from another Swiss institution / Funding from a foreign institution / Other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documents follow-on funding and types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejection of subsequent funding applications after Ambizione
rubrics_metrics.description: Were other applications of yours for further funding rejected after the end of the Ambizione grant? (No / Yes, namely: [details by source]).

rubrics_metrics.name: Current main job location and type
rubrics_metrics.description: Where is your current main job? (In Switzerland / In another country / I am not currently working). In what kind of institution is your main job? (university/university hospital; university of applied sciences; research facility outside academia; private sector/administration/NPO; other work).

rubrics_metrics.name: Still working at original Ambizione host institute
rubrics_metrics.description: Are you still working at your Ambizione host institution? (Yes / No)

rubrics_metrics.name: Current position description (career level)
rubrics_metrics.description: How can your current position be best described? (Full professor; Associate professor; Assistant professor [with tenure track]; Assistant professor [without tenure track]; SNSF professor; Scientific collaborator; Lecturer; Assistant; Postdoc; Other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standardized career-level categories to permit comparison.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attainment: Ambizione helps promote knowledge transfer in Switzerland
rubrics_metrics.description: How do you rate the statement 'Ambizione helps promote knowledge transfer in Switzerland'? (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of assessing overarching goals attainment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attainment: reintegration of Swiss researchers returning from abroad
rubrics_metrics.description: How do you rate the statement 'With an Ambizione grant, Swiss researchers returning from abroad can be reintegrated into the Swiss research community'? (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Attainment: integration of foreign researchers coming to Switzerland
rubrics_metrics.description: How do you rate 'With an Ambizione grant, foreign researchers coming to Switzerland are integrated into the Swiss science community'? (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Attainment: suitability for individuals with limited international mobility
rubrics_metrics.description: How do you rate 'Ambizione is particularly suited to funding individuals with limited international mobility'? (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Attainment: suitability for funding women scientists
rubrics_metrics.description: How do you rate 'Ambizione is particularly suited to funding women scientists'? (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential for improvement (open-ended)
rubrics_metrics.description: Do you see any potential for improvement with regard to the Ambizione funding scheme? (No / Yes, namely: [open text])
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Solicits suggestions for scheme design changes (e.g., request in report text to ease reallocation of budget items).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejected applicants: year of last application and reference to last application
rubrics_metrics.description: In which year did you submit your last application for an Ambizione grant? (I have never submitted an application for an Ambizione grant option also present).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies which application the respondent refers to.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejected applicants: motives for applying (same motive items as applicants/grantees)
rubrics_metrics.description: How significant were the listed motives for your (last) Ambizione application? (Same motive items and response scale as for grantees).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejected applicants: how they found envisaged host institute
rubrics_metrics.description: How did you find your envisaged Ambizione host institute? (multiple answers possible: personal contacts; earlier stays; already employed; recommended by mentors; found by other means).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejected applicants: reasons for choosing envisaged host institute
rubrics_metrics.description: Why did you choose your envisaged host institute? (multiple answers possible: reputation of host institute; reputation of scientists; importance in field; existing links; infrastructure; employment conditions; family/personal reasons; other).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejected applicants: phase of rejection (Phase 1 or Phase 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: In which phase was your (last) Ambizione application rejected? (Phase 1 i.e. before the interview / Phase 2 i.e. after the interview)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes stage at which application failed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejected applicants: reason for rejection (open-ended)
rubrics_metrics.description: Why was your proposal rejected? (open-ended)

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejected applicants: usefulness of SNSF comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Were the comments made by the SNSF useful to you? (Yes / No). Would you like to elaborate? (open-ended)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses feedback quality and utility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejected applicants: ability to conduct proposed research despite rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: Were you still able to conduct the research project for which you submitted the (last) Ambizione application? (Yes, to the same extent / Yes, but to a smaller extent / No). How did you secure funding? (open-ended)

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejected applicants: subsequent grants and employment at envisaged host
rubrics_metrics.description: Did you receive any other grant after your (last) Ambizione application was rejected? (No / Yes, namely: [options by source]). After rejection, were you employed at your envisaged Ambizione host institute thanks to funding from other sources? (Yes / No)

rubrics_metrics.name: SNSF project beneficiaries: baseline questions about first SNSF project grant
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have already received more than one SNSF project grant, please refer to your first SNSF project grant: year received, funding amount, duration (months), has the funded research project been completed? (Yes / No, not yet).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compare Ambizione to other SNSF schemes.

rubrics_metrics.name: SNSF project beneficiaries: experience of impacts from first project grant (same impact items as Ambizione grantees)
rubrics_metrics.description: My (first) SNSF project grant has... [same set of impact items: improved competence, enhanced profile, competitiveness, networking, access, publications number and quality]. (Very accurate / Rather accurate / Rather inaccurate / Completely inaccurate / No assessment possible)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables comparison between Ambizione and standard project grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: SNSF project beneficiaries: awareness of Ambizione and reasons for not applying
rubrics_metrics.description: Have you heard of the SNSF funding scheme Ambizione? (Yes / No). Why have you never applied for an Ambizione grant? (multiple answers possible: I did not meet participation requirements; Ambizione not appealing; could not find a host institute; did not feel scientifically independent enough; project funding better suited; other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses reach and attractiveness of Ambizione relative to other SNSF schemes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ambizione hosts: host background and discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: Background items for hosts: type of institution, main discipline and sub-discipline (multiple choice lists similar to other respondent groups).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to categorize hosts for comparative analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ambizione hosts: motivations to accept Ambizione grantee
rubrics_metrics.description: What motivated you to accept the Ambizione grantee? (multiple answers possible): Reputation of the researcher; Reputation of Ambizione; Reputation of the researcher's workplace; Knowledge transfer; Possibility of contacting researchers based abroad; Earlier cooperation with the researcher; Earlier employment of the researcher with different financing; Personal contact with the researcher; Research project in line with main topics (symmetry); Research project complements main topics (complementarity); Expansion of human or financial resources; Other reasons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documents host-side selection criteria and motivations.
